messages.text: {crew}. East champs. Out here that's a rumor, not a résumé.
Midwest crews play in sleet. First rung is Akron. Saturday. Wear sleeves.
we'll bring the heat
Ladder's up. Akron, Chicago, Detroit, St. Louis, Cleveland. Lou sent it at 5am.
it's 38 degrees in Akron. I own one jacket. it's a windbreaker
WE'RE EAST CHAMPS 👑 the page went from 40 followers to 312!!!
38 of those are Pops' church
Sister Ruth shares everything, youngin. That's reach.
Also the car heater's out. Bring blankets. This is not a joke.
Akron first. layers on
The Reaper's been watching {crew}. East champs. Cute.
Akron is where tires come to die. And crews. Mostly crews.
You'll hear the RAID ROCKET before you see it. Then you won't see anything.
bring a flashlight then
...we play at noon.
why he text like a movie trailer 😭 IN A WORLD...
Marauders are last on the ladder. but 5-0 when it's under 40 degrees. it's 38
Heater's still out. Blankets in the trunk. Pops gets the good one.
Rubber City, youngin. Everything bounces back up there. Don't let 'em.

you did not have to
Smokestack Slim slid into second and just kept going. Frozen dirt.

one down. Chicago next

doesn't matter. run it back

what you bring?
Rubber City legs. I bounce back. Eleven times, I bounced back.

Welcome to Chicago, {crew}. Wind's doing 30 off the lake.
We call it the Hawk. The Hawk catches everything. So do we.
Kick it high, the Hawk brings it back. TALON DIVE does the rest.
we kick low then
Then Juke King's already there. See you on the lakefront. 🦅
Kestrals turned 11 double plays this year. Juke King started all eleven
also I bought a coat. it was a lot of money. I don't want to talk about it
KEYS GOT A COAT 🧥😂 THE NUMBERS MAN IS WARM
Deep dish after. Table's booked. Win first or we eat at the gas station.
Wind ain't on nobody's team, youngin. Kick under it.
WE CLIPPED THE KESTRALS 🦅✂️ BIRD DOWN

DEEP DISH TIME 🍕🍕🍕

wear it to the rematch

you play smart?
I play cold. I juke. And I'm done kicking into the Hawk.

also heard your heater's out I'll fix it after we beat you free of charge no lie
you ever stop typing?
no
...he's not wrong about the heater.

WE DON'T DODGE WE DANCE 🕺 Detroit techno the whole ride up

WRECKED THE WRECKERS 🔨💥 THREE AND OH IN THE COLD
Motor Mouth didn't text for 40 minutes after. a record. for him
He fixed the heater anyway. Said a deal's a deal. The car is WARM, y'all.
TASHA'S CAR HAS HEAT 🔥 IT'S A NEW ERA
Respect your rivals, youngin. Some of 'em fix your heater.
three down. St. Louis
WRECKED told you heater offer still stands by the way no hard feelings drive safe
Taking him up on the heater. Then we beat him.
in that order
I'm a Wrecker but I don't like crashing into people. I like scoring.
Mack doesn't know what quiet is. Y'all play quiet. It works.
what you bring?
Assembly-line hands. Whatever you throw me, I catch. Every time. Like a factory.
Got a spot on {crew}?
Y'all came all the way hurr? 😂 Respect. Welcome to the Gateway.
Gateway to the West. For {crew} it's the exit.
GATEWAY BLAST goes over the Arch. Ask anybody who stood under it.
we'll stand under it saturday
Bring shades. The Arch reflects. 😎
Arches are 19-3. Big Muddy kicks it farther than the river is wide. I checked a map
THREE AND OH 🔥 THE ARCH IS GONNA BE THE BACKDROP FOR OUR PICTURE 📸
Toasted ravioli after. Not a typo. It's a real food. I'm excited.
River town, youngin. Don't swim against it. Ride it.

Big Muddy boomed two. we caught both. at the fence. felt like the Arch

Ten, youngin.
1,200 FOLLOWERS 😭 AND GUS FOLLOWED US BACK

tell us on the drive

we'll be back hurr. here. run it back
Gus makes everybody say hurr at practice. It's in the playbook. Page one.
I'm tired of being the Gateway. I wanna actually go somewhere.
where you trying to go?
Nationals. Same as y'all. I run hard and I've never missed a base. Ever.
Room for a St. Louis kid on {crew}?
Heard you beat the Arches. Clean. Cleveland respects clean.
Everybody sleeps on Cleveland. We like it. You wake up in the CRUSH ZONE.
Lakefront gets loud Saturday. Hope y'all like singing. 🎶
we like winning more
Then it'll be a good song either way.
Youngins. About Cleveland.
'98 Nationals were in Cleveland. We never saw it. Bus quit before the final.
wait. the bus story has a LOCATION?? eleven minutes and you never said a city
Never wanted to say it out loud, youngin.
THEN WE GO SAY IT FOR YOU 😤🙏
Heater works. Gas is full. We're getting to Cleveland this time.
for Pops
LADDER DONE!!! FIVE FOR FIVE IN THE COLD 🥶🔥
Rock Hall Ray threw 90 pitches. we kicked 31 of them hard. I'm proud of us
Lonnie sang the whole 9th. Even while losing. Respect.

it counts
Crush Zone. 🎶 Cleveland don't sleep, {crew}. Come back awake.
Lake ain't going nowhere, youngin. Neither are we.
run it back
Lonnie's my cousin. Don't tell him about this. Thanksgiving's already tense.
Watched y'all stand in the Crush Zone and not blink. I want that.
what you bring?
Lake-effect arm. Struck out Rock Hall Ray in practice. He doesn't talk about it.
Got room on {crew} for some Cleveland?
{crew}. Lou. Two seed. Last month you were a four. Notice that.

we'll be there

we'll fish it out

Cleveland. let's go

then we're still in it

so do we

midwest final. let's eat
